summary.text: Domonic Martin is the Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 44B, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026, and is running for one of the district's two seats alongside incumbent Democrats Aletheia McCaskill and Sheila Ruth.
